[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/4Xvwimq.png[/img][/center][center][size=3][/size][/center][quote][size=3]﻿﻿﻿﻿
[/size][center][size=3]A new village has recently been built north of Pelican Town, and its new residents seem... rather unusual.  You can find the entrance to Baldur's Village at the top of the southern mountain map, right next to Linus' tent.  

Baldur's Village is a large expansion mod for Stardew Valley, inspired by Baldur’s Gate 3. It introduces a brand-new village map and NPCs while staying true to the game's original atmosphere. Among them, Astarion features a fully developed personal storyline and is available for marriage. 
More content updates are planned for the future, including new gameplay features, additional NPCs, and new storylines and romances.

 鹈鹕镇北边最近新建了一座村庄，而新搬来的居民似乎有些……与众不同。你可以在山区地图顶端、莱纳斯帐篷旁找到通往博德之门村的入口。
博德村是一个以博德之门3为灵感制作的大型扩展Mod，为星露谷物语新增了一个全新的村庄地图和系列NPC，同时忠实于游戏原本的氛围。当前，阿斯代伦拥有完整的个人剧情，并可以与玩家结婚。之后会更新更多玩法并添加新的NPC和新的故事线、感情线。[/size][/center][/quote][center][/center][center][/center][color=#ff0000][b][size=4][center]
Disclaimer[/center][/size][/b][/color][center][size=3]Baldur's Village is a fan-made project, not an official story of Baldur’s Gate or Stardew Valley. This mod is created with respect and love for the original works, aiming to make the characters and their stories as engaging and authentic as possible.

﻿[/center][size=3]
[b]I haven't played Baldur's Gate 3. Can I still play this mod?
[/b]You can. You'll follow the new villagers' stories as a farmer, so prior BG3 experience isn't required to enjoy this mod. However, please note this mod contains lots[b] [/b]of [b][color=#ff0000]spoilers[/color][/b] since it takes place after BG3's ending. 
[i][size=3]Also, we highly recommend playing Baldur's Gate 3—it's a great game. I[/size]f playing our mod sparks your curiosity about Baldur's Gate 3 or the fascinating world of D&D, we'd be thrilled—that's exactly why we created it![/i][/size][b][size=3]

Why are the character‘s portraits not displaying correctly?[/size][/b][size=3]
Please download the Portraiture mod and place the BVportrait files into the Portraiture mod folder. For detailed instructions, refer to the sticky post on the Posts screen.
[/size][size=3]
[/size][size=3][b]Are you considering creating 64x64 portraits in the future?[/b]
[/size][size=3]No, [/size][size=3]we're not planning to create 64x64 portraits, as that resolution doesn't allow us to accurately portray the characters' appearances. Thanks for understanding!

[b]Do I need to start a new save to play this mod?[/b]
﻿No, this mod simply adds new content; it does not alter or break the original game.﻿

[b]Why do all the new characters stay in bed all day? Is that a bug?[/b]
Unfortunately, this is a known Context Patcher issue, not a bug with our mod. It occurs only when you add the mod mid-game(rather than from day one). They'll return to normal schedules the next day, so it won't affect gameplay. If you want to avoid this entirely, we recommend installing the mod before starting a new game.

[b]Is this mod compatible with SVE, RSV, and ES?[/b]
Yes! We've worked to ensure compatibility, but minor issues may occur due to limited testing. Please report any problems to us.
[b]
Will new character ﻿romance storylines be added in the future?[/b]
Yes! Our next focus will be creating Halsin’s romance storyline. Once completed, we will shift our attention to expanding the mod’s world-building, background stories, and gameplay by introducing new features and items.[/size][font=Arial][size=3]
